name: Crate
summary: A square download button that swings out a crate and fills it with flying parts of the file
about: Crate is a square, forest-green download button. Press it and a second box swings out beside it and flips its lid open; the arrow turns to point at it and glowing parts of the file arc across one by one, stacking up from the bottom row. When all 16 parts land, the lid slams shut, a badge pops and sparkles fly. It suits download pages, font packs and file libraries.
how: It squashes, then a crate swings out to its right and opens its lid while the arrow turns to point at it.
Parts of the file fly over in arcs and stack up from the bottom row, with the count and percent below.
When the crate is full, the lid slams shut, a tick badge pops with sparkles, then the crate tucks away and resets.
